description: One tracked run. Holds ONE encoded polyline for the whole run instead of one row per GPS ping — pings live in Redis and are summarised here exactly once, when the run closes.

fields.description: POS Profile name. The same value that must appear on the courier's Employee.branch — it is also the {branch} segment of the courier:loc:{branch}:{party} cache key.
fields.label: Branch

fields.description: Abandoned means the watchdog closed it: no ping for hours and nobody ended the duty. Kept distinct from Closed so a force-stopped app does not look like a normal end of day.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: Handset time of the newest accepted fix, written at most once a minute. This is what the stale-ping watchdog reads — the Redis position key expires, so it cannot be the watchdog's source.
fields.label: Last Ping On

fields.description: Fixes accepted into the trail. Not the number the client sent — noise-filtered and mocked fixes are excluded.
fields.label: Ping Count

fields.description: Fixes the handset itself flagged as coming from a mock location provider. Non-zero is worth a conversation; these never reach the trail, so they cannot affect distance.
fields.label: Mock Ping Count

fields.description: Google encoded polyline, precision 5. Written exactly once, when the run closes. There is no precision marker inside the string, so a reader assuming 6 will draw a line across the ocean.
fields.label: Polyline

fields.description: Sum of great-circle hops over the NOISE-FILTERED track: accuracy > 50 m dropped, movement < 20 m dropped as drift, implied speed > 120 km/h rejected. Without that filter a parked handset's jitter adds kilometres nobody rode.
fields.label: Actual Distance (m)

fields.description: Straight-line chain from where the run started through each delivered stop's address pin, in delivery order. The denominator of the detour ratio. 0 means it could not be computed (too few pinned stops).
fields.label: Planned Distance (m)

fields.description: Fixes the noise filter discarded when the polyline was built.
fields.label: Points Dropped

fields.description: Oldest fixes evicted by the trail cap before the run closed. Non-zero means the polyline is incomplete at its start and the distance understates the run.
fields.label: Points Truncated

fields.description: Set once the anomaly detector has looked at this run, so a repeated pass does not re-scan it.
fields.label: Anomalies Checked On

name: Courier Run
